failed.title: Outlooker could not start its database

failed.resetBody: This data folder holds a database from a different version of Outlooker, so it cannot be opened. Resetting deletes the database and creates an empty one in the same folder. All imported mail, saved queries, and PST sources are removed. Your PST files are not changed, and you can import them again afterwards.
